Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as 8bff7a1979751bd6fac351f79da8515f7b2e5f25
The commit message mentions "DeleteFRUVPD" update. Why is there a `GpioMonitor` change in this patch?

"DeleteFRUVPD"  API has been updated.
And so all the callers.
Acknowledged
i_sysConfigJsonObj, we are following this at most of the places so will help in maintaining the readability.
Acknowledged

Since we are making this code change to accommodate changes w.r.t worker. Can you remove the code making use of member worker and instantiate at the place of use itself?
This will reduce the scope of worker object and also this check won't be required.
Acknowledged
Instantiate worker here and call deleteFruVpd on that.
Acknowledged
i_configJson or i_sysConfigJson for better readability.
Acknowledged
Use reference instead of copying? You can pass it in place as well?
Done
Same here, reference or better extract and pass in place.
Done

Currently, we log a message and return if `m_configManager` is not initialized. With this change, we will log an Informational PEL.  This change is not mentioned in the commit message.Is this intended?

Also, `nullptr` check for `m_configManager` is already being done in `Listener` constructor. Do we need this check here anymore?

commit message updated.
2nd check we will keep as we discussed today.
Done
`nullptr` check for `m_configManager` is already being done in `Listener` constructor. Do we need this check here?
As discussed, this check doesn't add significant execution cost even though its redundant. I am fine with keeping this.

Nit: no need to mention api name PresentPropChanged.

there is log in the catch block already, so throwing required info would be enough.

ex: Config Manager object is null while processing FRU {l_objectPath}; present value: {l_present}.
Done

instead we can say l_chassisJson, which is widely used in the repository.

and we can also pass it to the api directly ?
Done

since processPreAction uses m_parsedJson for its operation,
if the worker object created without system config json path, then processPreAction will return without doing any operation as m_parsedJson will be empty.

 should Worker::deleteFruVpd api update m_parsedJson = i_configJsonObj as a first operation ?

This is a concern. Some of the API we pass the json, some of them access member config json. We should keep all the APIs in same pattern.
I am handling it now.
as mentioned above, this api also uses member m_parsedJson, so this will return without doing any operation.

as said above, we should handle it by following 1 pattern.
fixed.
